title: Compile-Time State Pipeline
goal: Chain typestate transitions in order to build a configured HTTP request.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Typestate Pattern

hints: The unconfigured `RequestBuilder<NoUrl>` must transition to `HasUrl` before headers can be added or requests sent.
`send()` consumes the builder and returns a `String`, so it must be the final method in the pipeline.
explanation: The builder transitions from `RequestBuilder<NoUrl>` to `RequestBuilder<HasUrl>` when `.url()` is called. Calling `.header()` or `.send()` before `.url()` fails with `E0599` because those methods are only implemented for `RequestBuilder<HasUrl>`. Calling `.header()` after `.send()` fails with `E0599` because `.send()` returns a `String` which does not have builder methods.
